observed_discontinuity: Closure run 35469009073 terminated simulator-real-apk with exit 124 at 180.161 seconds while the app process remained alive through its full 150-second observation interval.
required_semantics: An outer test timeout must exceed the maximum bounded duration of every inner observation and evidence collection step.
A harness timeout cannot be classified as an Android Runtime semantic failure.

call_path: run-suite starts real-APK regression with a 180-second bound
collector observes the app for 150 seconds
collector may issue two bounded 60-second log queries
outer timeout kills the still-valid collector

differences.description: The outer 180-second timeout was shorter than the inner declared maximum of 270 seconds.
differences.relevance: The harness necessarily can terminate a valid run before evidence collection completes.

first_relevant_difference: The outer suite timeout did not dominate the sum of the collector observation and bounded post-run queries.
host_adaptation: Not applicable; this is outside the Runtime.
